name: storage-local
title: Local file storage
description: File uploads to local disk: a 'file' resource, type and size allowlists, magic-byte checks and safe downloads.
docs:
Upload:   curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -F file=@photo.png http://localhost:5001/api/files/upload
Download: GET /api/files/:id/download   List: GET /api/files   Delete: DELETE /api/files/:id
Add uploads/ to .gitignore. Files are private to their owner; change policies in app/resources/file/file.resource.js.
